# City of Moses Lake

> > Official municipal website for Moses Lake, Washington, providing city services, permits, public records, and community resources.

The City of Moses Lake operates under Grant County, Washington, offering comprehensive municipal services including building permits, police records, utility billing, parks and recreation facilities, and city planning. The site serves residents, businesses, and visitors with information on city government, public safety, infrastructure, and community development.

## Key Topics

- Moses Lake
- Grant County
- Moses Lake City Council
- Community Development
- Building Permits
- MLPD (Moses Lake Police Department)
- Municipal Services
- Parks & Recreation
- Public Records
- Utility Billing
- Code Enforcement
- Planning Commission
- Transportation Benefit District
- Stormwater Management
- Fire Department Services

## City Services & Permits

- [Community Development](https://cityofml.com/45/Community-Development): Building permits, planning, zoning, code enforcement, and SEPA review
- [Permits](https://cityofml.com/1050/Permits): Building, fire, engineering, and water permit applications
- [Billing Information](https://cityofml.com/212/Billing-Information): Utility billing rates for water, garbage, and ambulance services
- [Report](https://cityofml.com/98/Report): Report code violations, graffiti, and service requests to the city

## City Planning & Finance

- [Financial Sustainability Plan](https://cityofml.com/1376/Financial-Sustainability-Plan): City Council's plan addressing budget deficit and municipal finance
- [Stormwater Comprehensive Plan](https://cityofml.com/1322/Stormwater-Comprehensive-Plan): Stormwater utility plan addressing MS4 Permit and UIC Program compliance
- [Transportation Benefit District](https://cityofml.com/891/Transportation-Benefit-District): TBD funding street maintenance via vehicle fees per RCW 36.73
- [Multi-Family Tax Exemption](https://cityofml.com/1101/Multi-Family-Tax-Exemption): MFTE program for affordable housing development and property tax exemption

## Public Safety & Records

- [Records](https://cityofml.com/425/Records): MLPD records unit for police records, licenses, and fingerprinting
- [EMT and Paramedic Students](https://cityofml.com/1304/EMT-and-Paramedic-Students): Moses Lake Fire Department ride-along and EMS precepting for students

## Resident Resources

- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://cityofml.com/FAQ.aspx): FAQ covering municipal services, court, and city government questions
- [Residential Yard Waste Collection](https://cityofml.com/665/Yard-Waste): Seasonal yard waste recycling program and collection guidelines
- [Snow Berms](https://cityofml.com/661/Snow-Berms): Snow removal and resident responsibilities per Municipal Code 8.14.020 C
- [Civic Center Facility Rental](https://cityofml.com/595/Civic-Center-Facility-Rental): Rent Civic Center facilities including auditorium and meeting spaces

## Parks & Recreation

- [Crossroads Park](https://cityofml.com/544/Crossroads-Park): Neighborhood park on Truman Drive with soccer field and picnic area
- [Gillette Park](https://cityofml.com/546/Gillette-Park): Neighborhood park on East 11th Avenue with playground and picnic area
- [John E. Calbom Island Park](https://cityofml.com/550/John-E-Calbom-Island-Park): Boat-access island park for wildlife viewing and natural habitat

## Optional

- [Art After Hours](https://cityofml.com/861/Art-After-Hours): Free adult craft events at Moses Lake Museum & Art Center
- [Notices of Potential Quorum](https://cityofml.com/1356/Notices-of-Potential-Quorum): City Council quorum notices for AGCCT meetings and community events
